notes: Standard locomotion: walk forward/back/strafe, run, sprint. Loop capable. Root motion variants. Core for all engagement profile bins.
Short dodge animations. Evasive roll. Dash forward/backward. These anchor Axis 1 mobility and Axis 4 dodger bin. Limited selection noted in community feedback — Mixamo's biggest gap for ARPG.
Punch combinations, kicks, unarmed strike. Covers close-range combat animation need. No weapon-specific variants in this subcategory.
Sword swing, slash, combo attacks. Weapon attachment point is right-hand bone. Multiple swing patterns (horizontal, vertical, diagonal). Important for warrior/rogue archetype animation.
Two-hand sword/axe/hammer animations. Slower attack tempo. Good for tank/warrior AOE swing archetypes.
Bow draw, aim, release. Ranged attack animation for hunter archetype. Weapon attachment: left hand (bow) + right hand (string).
Throwing animations. Cover multi_projectile geometry (simultaneous volley). Limited count.

Single or both-hand casting gestures. Used as base animation for all instant-cast spells. VFX attaches to hand bones or weapon bone. Core for all elemental mage archetypes. Most important Mixamo category for Reincarnated pipeline.
Sustained channeling animations. Loop capable. Used for beam_channel and aura geometry types. Key for control-pure archetypes. Limited selection.
Charge-up animations. Pre-release build-up. Used with charge timing mechanic. Very limited selection in Mixamo.
Shield block, weapon parry. Used for active mitigation defensive profile. Limited.
Hit-received reaction animations. Multiple directional variants (front/back/side). Critical for combat feel.
Death/fall animations. Multiple variants (dramatic/ragdoll-approximation/collapse). Not BC-relevant but required for complete kit.
Idle breath/sway/ambient animations. Required for character presentation. Loop capable.

CRITICAL GAP: Mixamo auto-rigger supports humanoid only. Non-humanoid monsters (spiders, dragons, quadrupeds) cannot use Mixamo. Custom rigging path required for non-humanoid enemy types. This is a major constraint for the ChatGPT→Meshy→Mixamo pipeline when generating monster characters.
